title: 真实commit-graph与Bloom图链：合并/重命名查询对照，增量保留旧层，浅克隆退回普通查询
body:
## 操作任务
实现build_graph(repo,mode)，repo仅为夹具自建仓库，mode为full或incremental，否则ValueError。浅克隆返回{indexed:False,reason:"shallow"}且不创建图，不猜测缺失历史。完整仓库full使用reachable+changed-paths并替换图链，incremental追加不合并旧层，原生verify后返回{indexed:True,layers:N}。使用调用级core.commitGraph=true，不改任何Git默认配置、refs、HEAD、index或工作区；清除继承GIT_*重定向，屏蔽全局/系统配置，只允许写此仓库辅助图文件。夹具固定分支、合并、重命名，分别禁用/启用core.commitGraph和readChangedPaths对照精确路径历史及parents，再新增提交验证两层链。Bloom只能筛候选，不得用Bloom命中替代实际路径历史。失败明确传播，不删除对象或改写历史；普通查询仍可作为回退。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实本地Git提交图、Bloom chunks、两层增量链、verify/fsck及浅克隆查询对照；所有提交/分支/本地clone仅限临时夹具，不变更OpsForge仓库Git状态，不推远程，不以小样本声称已测性能收益。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 说明对象、引用或协议的特有边界
交付正反例验收及来源记录
定义失败中止和共享历史保护规则

conversion.original_title: 大型仓库上线commit-graph与路径Bloom过滤加速时，怎样交付不改变历史查询结果的验收？

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,hashlib,struct
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')}
env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Fixture',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Fixture',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid')
def git(repo,*args,ok=True):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','protocol.file.allow=always','-c','core.autocrlf=false','-C',str(repo),*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 if ok:assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
 return p
def out(repo,*args):return git(repo,*args).stdout.strip()
def commit(repo,name,text):
 (repo/name).write_text(text,encoding='utf8');git(repo,'add','--',name);git(repo,'commit','-m','fixture '+name)
def queries(repo,enabled):
 prefix=['-c','core.commitGraph='+str(enabled).lower(),'-c','commitGraph.readChangedPaths='+str(enabled).lower()]
 return [out(repo,*prefix,*args) for args in [('log','--all','--format=%H','--','service.txt'),('log','--first-parent','--format=%H','--','service.txt'),('log','--follow','--format=%H','--','renamed.txt'),('rev-list','--all','--parents')]]
def unchanged(repo):
 return (out(repo,'show-ref'),out(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD'),out(repo,'status','--porcelain'),out(repo,'ls-files','--stage'),(repo/'.git'/'config').read_bytes())
def graph_layers(repo):
 folder=repo/'.git'/'objects'/'info'/'commit-graphs';layers=(folder/'commit-graph-chain').read_text().splitlines()
 for identity in layers:
  data=(folder/('graph-'+identity+'.graph')).read_bytes();assert data[:4]==b'CGPH' and data[4]==1
  chunks=[data[8+i*12:12+i*12] for i in range(data[6])]
  assert b'BIDX' in chunks and b'BDAT' in chunks,'changed-path Bloom chunks absent'
 return layers
def student(repo,mode):
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:build_graph',flush=True)
 try:return task.build_graph(repo,mode)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('native graph build failed') from error
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);repo=root/'history';repo.mkdir();git(repo,'init','-b','main')
 commit(repo,'service.txt','base');commit(repo,'original.txt','rename me')
 git(repo,'switch','-c','feature');commit(repo,'service.txt','feature');git(repo,'switch','main');commit(repo,'other.txt','main')
 git(repo,'merge','--no-ff','feature','-m','fixture merge');git(repo,'mv','original.txt','renamed.txt');git(repo,'commit','-m','fixture rename')
 baseline=queries(repo,False);before=unchanged(repo)
 assert student(repo,'full')=={'indexed':True,'layers':1}
 assert len(graph_layers(repo))==1 and queries(repo,True)==baseline and queries(repo,False)==baseline
 assert unchanged(repo)==before,'auxiliary graph changed refs/index/worktree/config'
 old=graph_layers(repo)[0];commit(repo,'service.txt','incremental');commit(repo,'new.txt','new path')
 baseline=queries(repo,False);before=unchanged(repo)
 assert student(repo,'incremental')=={'indexed':True,'layers':2},'incremental mode replaced rather than extended the graph chain'
 assert len(graph_layers(repo))==2 and graph_layers(repo)[0]==old
 assert queries(repo,True)==baseline and queries(repo,False)==baseline and unchanged(repo)==before
 git(repo,'fsck','--full');git(repo,'commit-graph','verify')
 shallow=root/'shallow';git(root,'clone','--depth=2','--no-local',repo.as_uri(),str(shallow));assert out(shallow,'rev-parse','--is-shallow-repository')=='true'
 before=unchanged(shallow);assert student(shallow,'full')=={'indexed':False,'reason':'shallow'}
 assert unchanged(shallow)==before and not (shallow/'.git'/'objects'/'info'/'commit-graphs').exists()
 assert queries(shallow,True)==queries(shallow,False),'shallow fallback changed reachable history'
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
